previous_attempt_findings: Maturin's source-distribution build rewrote Cargo.lock without --locked; the package build now uses --locked, and the locked build preserves the reviewed lockfile.
Maturin's default build placed executables in target/debug while the verifier correctly trusted target/release; release_build.py now requests --release and verifies against release outputs.
The Maturin PKG-INFO description parser decoded UTF-8 via an ASCII-compatible email policy; it now decodes the declared UTF-8 payload directly.
environment.provenance_boundary: The verifier pins the packaged executable bytes to the local Cargo release outputs and records source/product/protocol/semantic identity. It does not establish publisher authenticity, trusted provenance against a malicious build host, or sandbox the executable.
